subtitle: On-device AI assistant
promotional_text: Chat with AI on your phone. No Wi-Fi required. Free forever. On-device model runs locally — your conversations never leave your device.
description:
AGI runs on your device first. No cloud required, no account needed, no data leaving your phone for Local Mode.

Most AI apps funnel your conversations through remote servers. AGI is different: responses can be generated by an open-source language model running on your device. Airplane mode? Still works. No Wi-Fi? Still works.

WORKS OFFLINE
The default model downloads once over Wi-Fi and runs locally after that. No Local Mode inference calls hit AGI Cloud. Your local conversations stay on this device and are encrypted at rest.

FREE AT INFERENCE, FOREVER
Local on-device inference is free and always will be. There is no usage limit, no per-message charge, no subscription required to use the core chat.

CLOUD WHEN YOU CHOOSE IT
AGI Cloud is in public alpha: sign in for cloud chat and web search on the free tier, with image generation on Pro and above. There are no in-app purchases in this version.

PRIVACY FIRST
We do not claim full DPDP Act 2023 compliance. Our itemised India DPDP notice is published at https://agiworkforce.com/privacy/india, and the obligations we have not met — verifiable parental consent, notice in Eighth Schedule languages, and India data residency among them — are listed at https://agiworkforce.com/trust. AI output is labelled as AI-generated, and first run names the on-device model and any cloud provider. Local Mode collects no personal data by default. Signing in to AGI Cloud uses your account email (and name, if provided by your sign-in method) to create your account. Export or delete your local data at any time from Settings.

INDIA-FIRST
AGI is designed to work well on the connections and devices common across India: it runs offline, installs once, and handles Hindi queries.

Built by AGI Automation LLC, USA.
Support: support@agiworkforce.com
Privacy: https://agiworkforce.com/privacy

age_rating.note: 12+ chosen to align with age-gate default (13+). 4+ may also qualify for the default experience; 12+ is the conservative choice given AI-generated text output.

data_linked_to_you.collected_when: Only when the user signs in to use AGI Cloud (public alpha). Email is required to create the account; name is collected if provided by the sign-in method.
Only in AGI Cloud: the messages the user sends and any photos or files attached to them are uploaded to AGI Cloud and forwarded to the model provider serving the request. Local Mode uploads nothing.

Only after sign-in: the account identifier on every authenticated cloud request, and an app-generated device UUID registered with the push token so notifications reach the right install. No advertising identifier is collected.

privacy_nutrition_labels.note: Local Mode collects no personal data by default and uploads nothing. Signing in to AGI Cloud (public alpha, open to any signed-in user) collects account email, optional name, account and device identifiers, and the conversation content and attachments the user sends. Conversation content is processed by the model-provider subprocessors listed at https://agiworkforce.com/subprocessors on AGI's behalf; it is never used to track the user across other companies' apps or websites.

pricing.in_app_purchase_note: Native store billing code SHIPS in the v1.2.0 binary and is deployment-gated OFF, so nothing is purchasable and in_app_purchases stays false. What ships: expo-iap 5.3.0 is a dependency and a registered config plugin in apps/mobile/app.config.js, so StoreKit 2 is linked, and src/features/billing/useMobileIap.ts drives a real purchase flow rendered by src/features/settings/cloud-billing/index.tsx. Why nothing can be bought: every purchase path requires GET /api/mobile/iap/catalog to report the catalog as enabled, and apps/web/lib/server/mobile-iap-catalog.ts only does that when MOBILE_IAP_ENABLED is set AND MOBILE_IAP_APPLE_PRODUCT_IDS_JSON maps at least one logical product key to a store ID. The gate fails closed, so with either missing the catalog comes back disabled with 'Native purchases are not enabled for this deployment.' and Settings > Billing renders the inert 'Native purchases are not configured' notice in place of the whole native-purchase area — no product row, no store price, no restore action, no store sheet. The checked-in env templates ship MOBILE_IAP_ENABLED=false and define no product-ID map (apps/web/.env.example, apps/web/.env.local.example); the live flag state is a deployment setting this repo cannot prove, and is confirmed off before every submission. The rest of that screen still renders the plan card, the plan-change row, the invoices row, and — for an active web-billed plan only — two static info blocks about proration and how a store top-up would be priced; REVIEWER-NOTES-IOS.md enumerates all of them so the 'no price' claim is not read wider than the native-purchase area. No App Store Connect in-app-purchase product exists for com.agiworkforce.app: MOBILE_IAP_PRODUCT_DEFINITIONS in packages/contracts/types/src/mobile-iap.ts holds logical keys only, and /api/mobile/iap/verify rejects any product it cannot resolve from that same gated catalog, so no entitlement can be granted through StoreKit while the gate is off. The plan-change CTA never shows a price or a checkout, but it has two branches and only one is a sheet: an account with no subscription on record gets the in-app PaywallBottomSheet reading 'Plan changes aren't available in the app yet. Check back soon.' with no action button, while an account whose subscription is on record as bought elsewhere (web/Stripe or org-provisioned, and not cancelled or expired) gets a native 'Subscription managed elsewhere' alert whose second button opens agiworkforce.com/settings/billing externally — that is the fourth link in guideline_3_1_1_residual_risk, and getSubscriptionOwnerGuard in src/features/billing/subscriptionSource.ts decides which branch. FEATURES.billing is false in apps/mobile/lib/v1FeatureFlags.ts so the 'Manage billing' row and the Stripe billing-portal link do not render. The description sentence 'There are no in-app purchases in this version.' stays accurate only because nothing is purchasable. Flip in_app_purchases to true, rewrite that sentence, and update REVIEWER-NOTES-IOS.md in the same change once real products are registered and MOBILE_IAP_ENABLED is on (in-repo claims verified 2026-08-27 against the files named here).
pricing.guideline_3_1_1_residual_risk: Four external links remain — the count was three until the openExternalUrl call sites were enumerated exhaustively on 2026-08-27 — all disclosed to App Review in REVIEWER-NOTES-IOS.md and tracked as MOBILE-IOS-3-1-1-EXTERNAL-LINKS in docs/agent-context/known-flaws.md, whose entry still records only the first three and must be corrected: (1) Settings > Billing > 'View invoices' opens agiworkforce.com/billing, rendered only for accounts already on a paid plan (free tier gets an inert 'No invoices yet' row); (2) 'Contact Sales' opens agiworkforce.com/contact-sales for the team/enterprise tiers only, reached from the chat paywall because getNextUpgradeTier never returns those tiers; (3) 'Workspace administration' opens agiworkforce.com/settings/team for team admins only; (4) 'Manage on web' on the 'Subscription managed elsewhere' alert opens agiworkforce.com/settings/billing, reached from the plan-change row for any account whose subscription is on record as bought elsewhere and not cancelled or expired (showSubscriptionOwnerGuard in src/features/settings/cloud-billing/index.tsx, URL from subscriptionManagementUrl in src/features/billing/subscriptionSource.ts). All four call sites verified 2026-08-27 in src/features/settings/cloud-billing/index.tsx, src/features/billing/subscriptionSource.ts and src/features/chat/components/PaywallBottomSheet.tsx. Whether to gate or remove them is a founder product/legal decision — the shipped StoreKit code is gated off and does not resolve this on its own.

export_compliance.info_plist_key: ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption=false, declared in ios.infoPlist in apps/mobile/app.config.js
export_compliance.basis: All cryptography is Apple OS-provided: TLS via URLSession, Keychain via expo-secure-store, SecRandomCopyBytes via expo-crypto, and SQLCipher compiled with -DSQLCIPHER_CRYPTO_CC (ExpoSQLite.podspec) so its codec calls Apple CommonCrypto. No proprietary or bundled third-party cipher ships in apps/mobile. Flip to true and obtain an export-compliance code if that ever changes.

availability.territories: All App Store territories excluding: Mainland China, Russia, Iran, North Korea, Syria, Cuba, Crimea
